author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅರಿಗಳನು ಗುರುತಿಸುತ ಎಚ್ಚರದಿ ನಡೆಯುತಿರು
ಗುರಿಸೇರೆ ನಿನಗವರೆ ದಾರಿ ದೀಪಗಳು
ಅರಿತವರ ಶಕ್ತಿಯುತ ಸಾಂಗತ್ಯ ದೊರೆಯುತಿರೆ
ದರಿದಾಟೆ ಸುಲಭವಹು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Recognise your enemies and walk alert;
to reach your goal, they themselves become your lamps on the road;
when you have the strong company of those who know,
crossing the valley becomes easy, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Knowing our adversaries, inner and outer, keeps us alert and even shows us the way. With wise companions, difficult crossings become easy.
